configured_broker_limits.scope: Per Broker; repair packages get fresh Broker budgets. Sol token usage and output-token enforcement unavailable.

correction_policy: Only frozen generic CLI criticism, concrete refutation, compiler feedback and ordinary bounded repair; no controller candidate edits or task-specific hints.
hidden_test_policy: No oracle, withheld cases, expected values or historical artifacts to generators. Independent checks start only after the arm finishes and never drive repair.
historical_policy: Archives/scores unchanged; describe historical audited outcomes separately without rescoring/pooling.

preflight.scope: Authored offline transport/protocol/grader fixtures; no measured generation

preparation_failure: ../paired-001/PREPARATION-FAILURE.json (no generation; excluded from all task scores)
raw_success_predicate: Exact single direct response origin; unchanged inputs; worker exit0; all160 independent cases pass in both fresh isolated harnesses. No formal milestone.
strict_success_predicate: Native CLI PASS/exit0; unchanged inputs; exact validated repair lineage and model artifact origin; native Tier0 TESTED/review/closure gates with two clean builds; all160 independent cases pass in both fresh isolated harnesses.
trusted_components: Lean4 kernel/toolchain and strict-policy built-in axioms
Controller exact copying of collaboration final messages
Collaboration override requested; actual identity/sampling/tokens/carrier-only access unattested
